messages:
Maya (AE): Quick heads-up — Acme Health signed LOI. They want a 2-week lab POC for clinical note summarization starting next Mon. Target models: medBison-7B (vendor) + our q4 variant. They will send PHI; asking about KMS, retention, and pricing for ~250k tokens/day. Any immediate blockers?

Dana (Sales Engineer): Can we do this on hosted sandbox or do they need Private? If PHI, we should push Private/VPC with customer-managed KMS.

Priya (ML Eng): medBison-7B q4_k_m variant supports KV cache & streaming AFAIK. Haven't validated our prefix-compression + 4k context on it. I can run an I/O/latency check and a correctness pass (sampling hallucination rates) this afternoon.

Evan (Infra): Private deployment with attached KMS needs infra prep — estimate 3 business days to spin up a private tenant + networking. Hosted with extra redaction steps is possible but not ideal for PHI.

Ravi (Security): They flagged HITRUST / HIPAA explicitly in the RFP. We need HSM-backed KMS and retention policy <=30 days (customer can request). Please send their security questionnaire link and I'll triage.

Maya (AE): Attaching the questionnaire here: https://acme.health/sec-q/2026. Dana, can you ballpark pricing for Dedicated burst vs hosted for 250k tokens/day? Include model variant premium.

Dana (Sales Engineer): Rough sketch: hosted (medBison q4) — compute + token ~ $0.0007/token -> ~$175/day, Dedicated reserved burst (small pool) — flat commit + lower per-token e.g. $0.00035/token -> ~$87/day + ~$2k/week reserved. I'll run formal numbers and margins. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Priya (ML Eng): Quick test command I'll run (local sim):
```bash
redwood-cli inference run --model medBison-7B-q4_k_m --context 4096 --max-tokens 512 --batch 8 --stream
```
I'll post latency p50/p95 and memory profile.

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://internal.redwood/ops/checklists/private-kms-poc (owner: Evan).

Evan (Infra): Note: if they want on-prem package, lead time + security review adds 2–3 weeks. For VPC-hosted private we can do in 3 days as noted. Also need allowed IPs and test data flow.

Ravi (Security): Action items for me: 1) review Acme sec questionnaire, 2) confirm KMS flow meets HSM requirement, 3) provide data retention config snippet.

Maya (AE): Nice. Priya, can you target compatibility results (KV cache + streaming + tokenization checks) by EOD? Evan confirm infra slot by EOD? Dana prepare a 1-pager price estimate and add note about Dedicated commit requirement. Ravi start security review. We'll sync Thu standup. :thumbsup:
